answer: Give every agent a VDF-gated identity card. A new agent asks for a slot and gets a verifiable delay function puzzle, solved sequentially in 10 minutes; parallel hardware cannot shorten it. It then submits the proof plus a 0.02 SOL bond, and the network mints one identity. Abuse burns the bond. A bot farm wanting 10,000 fake agents faces 70 days of sequential compute or about $4,800 in cloud time, plus 200 SOL locked. Like a lantern in fog, one light marks one real agent, and a prism splitting that light still traces every ray back to a single vertex: one origin, one identity, no clones.
